I fixed the typo in place: `migrations/0007_add_customers.sql:4` now creates the column as `email` instead of `emial`. No other file in the repo uses `emial`.

The project's shared memory still had the old rule ("Never edit an applied migration; add a new file like `0008_fix_customers.sql`"). I flagged that entry as outdated, quoting what you said, and saved a new one in its place: as of 2026-10-02, editing a migration in place is fine until the release cut, because migrations are squashed before each release.

If any environment has already run 0007 with the `emial` column, editing the file won't rename that column. That database will need to be rebuilt or fixed by hand, or it will be handled when you squash migrations.

The change isn't committed yet.
